rationale: The stock gapped down ~17% on a significant earnings miss (EPS -36%, revenue -22%) with 8x relative volume, creating a highly uncertain post-gap environment. Price is currently sitting mid-range (42.3%) between today's high and low, below both VWAP ($17.49) and the 9-EMA ($17.45), with the last few 1-minute candles showing a modest uptick — but no clear directional conviction. The fundamental catalyst is bearish, yet the gap may already be largely priced in; without a clean technical setup at a defined level (e.g., a retest of the low or a reclaim of VWAP with momentum), the risk/reward is insufficient to justify adding exposure alongside two already-working orders.
